en.shortDescription: Open-source headless CMS and data platform
en.longDescription:
Directus is an open-source headless CMS that wraps any SQL database with a real-time API and admin app.

Includes PostgreSQL. Secrets use SERVICE_HEX_32_DIRECTUS, SERVICE_HEX_64_DIRECTUS, SERVICE_USER_DIRECTUS, and SERVICE_PASSWORD_DIRECTUS.
